svg.text: Camel Crossing Highway Safety (Camel Guard) — Wiring Diagram

Miniature simulator · firmware 2.3.1 · camel gate: 2× IR obstacle + PIR · cars: 2× HC-SR04 at the 400 m points · 2× 74HC595 (one per direction) · buzzer · solar panel + battery measured by 2× INA219 (I2C)
2× INA219 on I2C: D17 = SDA · D16 = SCL
see the power path at the bottom of the page
side-A · 400 m point · beside the lane, across
side-B · 400 m point · beside the lane, across
camel gate · side-B edge of the crossing
camel gate · side-A edge of the crossing
HC-SR04 (cars): beside each lane at the 400 m point, pinging across.
ECHO is 5 V: never connect it to the ESP32 without the divider.
74HC595 pinout — DIP-16, top view (notch on the left)
Pin 1 = dot / next to the notch. Blue numbers = pin numbers used in the diagram.
• Supply: solar panel → TP4056 → 18650 → MT3608 (5.1 V) → VIN
• A 5 V ≥ 2 A USB adapter / power bank works too (bench, backup)
• All GND connected together (ESP32, sensors, LEDs, power)
1. Camel gate: IR A (side-A edge) · PIR (middle) · IR B (side-B edge).
Camel = IR trigger + PIR motion within 3 s; first IR = its side.
2. IR: FC-51, VCC 3.3 V, OUT active LOW. PIR: VCC 5 V, OUT 3.3 V.
3. Cars: 2× HC-SR04 at the 400 m points, ≤ 15 cm across the lane = car.
ECHO is a 5 V signal: always through the 1 kΩ / 2 kΩ divider.
4. Side A: signs 300/200/100 m, signal A; car at A → A signs fast. Same B.
5. D0, D2, D5, D12, D15 are strapping pins: no sensor on them.
6. Free: D21 / D22, D34, D35, VP, VN.
7. Self-test at power-on: chip #1 (side A) Q0 → Q6, then chip #2 (B).
8. ≈ 6 mA per LED output; bigger signs: NPN or ULN2803 driver.
100 nF across pins 16–8. Q0 = pin 15, Q1…Q7 = pins 1…7.
10. INA219 #1 (0x40) on the solar input, #2 (0x41, A0 bridged) on the
battery: positive current = charging. Not fitted = USB still works.
Solar panel + battery — power supply and measurement (2× INA219 on the I2C bus)
• INA219 #1: panel V, mA, W; “sun” above 4.5 V
• INA219 #2: battery V (≈ %), mA; + charging, − discharging
• States: charging · full (≥ 4.10 V) · on battery · idle
• Battery low below 3.45 V (clears above 3.60 V)
• Not fitted at power-on: skipped (USB still works)
• Stops answering later: fault INA-S / INA-B
• Wrong sign? swap VIN+ / VIN− or INA_*_INVERT in config.h
